title: Content OS Registry Block/Component v1
description: Reusable block (sub-composition) or component (effect snippet) entry in the local Content OS registry. Hash-bound, offline-first, seek-safe, deterministic.

id.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the block's internal composition ID.

dimensions.description: WxH. Required for type=block; forbidden for type=component.

duration_s.description: Required for type=block; forbidden for type=component.

files.description: Relative paths to block/component files inside registry/.

sha256.description: sha256 of the primary block file (UTF-8).

seek_safe.description: true = GSAP timeline paused, scrubbed, no repeat:-1/relative +=/transition. Required true for blocks with timeline.

offline.description: true = no external assets, no network, no Google Fonts CDN. Required true.

composition_id.description: Internal composition ID for blocks; must match data-composition-id used in wiring.
